login.approvalNote: New accounts must be approved by an administrator before they can be used.
approval.pendingBody: Your account ({email}) has been created. An administrator needs to approve it before you can use MeetNotes. You can use the app as soon as you are approved.
approval.rejectedBody: An administrator has not approved this account. Contact them if you think this is a mistake.
admin.title: User approvals
login.name: Full name
login.resetHelp: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
login.resetSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.
login.checkEmailConfirm: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.
login.alreadyExists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in or reset your password.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
login.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

record.tamilNote: Tamil speech recognition is still limited and often makes mistakes. Check important details against the audio.
tedit.hint: Ctrl+Enter to save, Esc to cancel
notesStale.banner: The transcript was edited after these notes were written.
notesStale.confirm: Replace the summary, decisions and action items with new ones written from the edited transcript? Your changes to them (including ticked action items) will be lost.
consent.title: Recording consent
consent.label: I confirm that everyone who can be heard has been told this is being recorded and agrees to it, or that I am otherwise legally allowed to record them.
consent.help: Recording rules differ by country and state: some places require everyone’s consent. This is a reminder, not legal advice.
consent.notice: This meeting is being audio-recorded and turned into a written transcript and notes by MeetNotes. If you do not agree to be recorded, please tell the organiser now.
usage.title: Usage and AI limit
usage.explain: AI units are Cloudflare Workers AI “neurons”. Turning speech into text and writing the notes both use them.
usage.state.paused: Paused: the daily limit is reached
usage.free: Free allowance: {n} units a day for the whole Cloudflare account.
usage.costFree: No charge expected: within the free allowance.
usage.empty: No AI usage in this period.
usage.capHelp: When today’s total reaches this number, new processing pauses for everyone until 00:00 UTC. 0 turns the cap off. Keep it below the free allowance if you want to avoid charges.
usage.confirmOff: Turn the daily cap off? A busy day could go past the free allowance and be charged.
insights.title: Insights
insights.topicsHelp: Words that keep coming up in your notes, counted by how many meetings mention them.
insights.empty: Insights appear once you have finished a few meetings.
